_comment: NPC: Mu Bingmei (Liu Mei) (木冰眉 / 柳眉). Canon ID: N19. CRON-COMPLETIONIST-111: registered as a canon NPC at the Kunxu Realm (昆虚界) where she takes Zhou Ru as her disciple. Per user directive: every miscellaneous NPC from RI must be accounted for. Prime Directive: Reality is objective; cultivation changes understanding, not existence. Every being described here exists independently of the player's perception.
name: Mu Bingmei (Liu Mei)
personality: cold exterior, complex interior; rival-turned-love-interest; master to Zhou Ru
relationship_to_wanglin: complex love interest; rival then lover; third wife; karmic ties severed via Dream Dao

perception_tiers.soul_formation: Ascendant+; Zhou Ru's master in the Kunxu Realm

note: Complex love interest; rival-turned-lover; Wang Lin's third wife; Zhou Ru's cultivation master in the Kunxu Realm

dao_heart.note: 0-100. A cracked Dao heart blocks breakthrough regardless of Qi. Per canon: Wang Lin's Dao heart is famously tested at every major realm.

canon_notes.true_identity: Mu Bingmei (木冰眉) is Liu Mei's (柳眉) true form — they are the same person. Liu Mei is Mu Bingmei's ninth avatar (第九分身); Mu Bingmei is the 7th-generation Saintess of the Kunxu Realm (昆虚之境).
canon_notes.wang_lin_relationship: Wang Lin's third wife. Had a son with Wang Lin (Wang Ping 王平) whom she refined into a resentful spirit out of hatred. Wang Lin severed karmic ties with her via the Dream Dao (梦道); one of his clones accompanies her.
canon_notes.zhou_ru_master: She entered the Kunxu Realm (昆虚界) and took Zhou Ru (周茹) as her disciple. Zhou Ru's cultivation arc (mortal → Soul Transformation) takes place here under Mu Bingmei's guidance. This is the post-transfer cultivation arc (CRON-110 soul transfer → CRON-111 cultivation growth).
canon_notes.sources: RICanonicalDatabase N19 + L74; Baidu Baike (木冰眉 — https://baike.baidu.com/item/木冰眉/8802287); Fandom wiki. NO fabricated chapter citation.

initiation_lines: I am Mu Bingmei. The Kunxu Realm is my retreat. Few find their way here uninvited.
Liu Mei was my ninth avatar (第九分身), walking the mortal world in my stead. Mu Bingmei is my true name.
Zhou Ru is my disciple. Her soul carries a burden I understand — Wang Lin's love is not a gentle thing.
The Dream Dao severed what bound us. Yet his clone walks beside me still. Such is the way of karma.
If you seek to cultivate under me, bring the Kunxu Realm's spirit herbs. I will not teach the unprepared.

daily_schedule.action: Pre-dawn cultivation in the Kunxu Realm's central spirit vein
Instruct Zhou Ru in cultivation technique
Solo meditation on the Dream Dao
Refine spirit herbs from the Kunxu Realm
Guide Zhou Ru through cultivation breakthrough
